exposure: Number of prior cesarean deliveries (1, 2, 3, 4 or more)
cohort: 1,747,610 women with low-risk pregnancies undergoing repeat cesarean delivery between 37 and 41 weeks of pregnancy in the US
finding: An increasing number of prior cesarean deliveries was associated with a higher risk of both maternal and neonatal adverse outcomes in women with low-risk pregnancies undergoing repeat cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: An increasing number of prior cesarean deliveries was associated with a higher risk of adverse outcomes, suggesting that repeat cesarean deliveries carry increasing risks.
